$comment: PLACEMENTS FOR CALLS WHOSE ONLY CORPUS AUTHORINGS ARE SUBSET UNITS. One row per book card: which WHOLE-SET board the call is placed on, and why. A row is a CLAIM, not a switch: `book/tools/make-virtual.mjs` re-derives the placement, refuses an ambiguous one, and refuses one the PERMISSION RULES deny - the whole-square reading of Circle Four is illegal (`PERMISSION_RULES`: 'the whole square cannot circle four'), and the generator now asks before it draws. `refused: true` records the opposite claim - that NO reading of the call is permitted at Mainstream - and the generator checks that too, so a refusal is measured rather than asserted.

m01b.title: Circle Four Left
m01b.why: Circle Four is a FOUR-dancer call: `PERMISSION_RULES` denies the All 8 reading and allows Heads and Sides, so the placement taken is the PARTIAL one covering the Sides - four dancers circle while the other four hold. The tiled placement on the same board also stands up geometrically and is exactly the illegal picture that rule exists to prevent.

m01c.title: Single Circle Left
m01c.why: The family is WITHHELD at Mainstream: the corpus authors it two dancers at a time and names no `actives`, so no reading says which dancers circle. MEASURED over seven whole-set boards, no candidate carries an allowed reading - the deny has no group or board condition - so there is nothing legal to draw.

m02.title: Dosado
m02.why: The manual's own start is the square set, and the All 8 reading THERE is denied ('a Static Square is not Facing Dancers ... the tiling can pair them six apart, but only by walking the bodies through each other'). Facing lines is the board where the whole-square Dosado is a legal reading, so the card is drawn from there.

m03d.title: Wrong Way Promenade
m03d.why: The manual's first start is Squared Set; a square places it tiled and starts and ends on Static Square, and the All 8 reading is permitted.

m11.title: Swing Your Partner
m11.why: Four couples swing in place; a square holds four of them, and the All 8 reading is permitted. Eight Chain Thru and Double Pass Thru are REFUSED by chooseVirtual for this call (equally good placements), which is why the board is named here.

m16.title: Lead Right
m16.why: The only placement on a square is PARTIAL over the Sides, which the Lead Right white list allows ('each for a single couple to dance'); the whole-square reading is denied by the rule that starts that white list.

m19e.title: Box Circulate
m19e.why: Two boxes are what a Double Pass Thru carries; the placement is tiled over All 8, ends on Completed Double Pass Thru, and the All 8 reading is permitted.

m30.title: Box the Gnat
m30.why: Four facing couples place Box the Gnat tiled over All 8 and end on Eight Chain Thru, with the All 8 reading permitted. Static Square also places it, but PARTIALLY and onto a T-Bone whose pair no group name covers.
